title: Great historical tour
text: Estella was a terrific tour guide.  Extremely knowledgable and very personable.  She had a great understanding of the Jewish history in Sevilla and great presentation.  Enjoyed the tour very much and would highly recommend her as your tour guide.
author: John_R

title: A Pleasant Surprise!
text: I must say this tour was a pleasant surprise. Our guide, Susanna was fantastic. She guided us through areas we would never have thought to visit in our own and gave us a great history lesson along the way.  One place in particular she brought us to is the Hotel Las Casas de la Juderia.  This place is a charming and magical place that all should visit. In particular, Susanna encouraged us to return after 6:30 pm to visit the Piano Bar.  We are so happy we took her advice. It was more charming than expected and the piano player was phenomenal, taking recommendations from those sitting around lis
author: Joshua_D

title: Great tour!
text: Susanna was a very good guide she combines knowledge of her subject with a warm engaging manner, two hours went by very quickly. Highly recommend.
author: Robert_B

title: Wonderful Guide but little left of Seville’s Jewish History.
text: Our guide Moisés was excellent. Well informed, interested in our input and we would highly recommend him for any tour of Seville. It was one our most pleasant afternoons and so informative.
author: Barry_R

title: Santa Cruz Neighborhood
text: Excellent tour of the Santa Cruz neighborhood in Seville. We covered lots of fascinating sites and lots of history. Great foundation for the rest of our stay in Seville. Lovely walk on a beautiful day too!
author: DCNinethou
